summary: Create a new Time And Material Entry
description: Create a new Time And Material Entry associated with the specified project. Custom fields configured on the Time & Material entry fieldset are accepted and returned.

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description: If true, validations are run for the corresponding Configurable Field Set.
